content.short: VSCode Solidity Auditor provides Solidity language support and a visual security auditor for Visual Studio Code.
content.description: VSCode Solidity Auditor is a Visual Studio Code extension that extends the editor with Solidity language support and security-focused tooling. It debuted on the VS Code marketplace in 2021. The extension helps developers build safer Solidity contracts by using a listing feature that boosts security awareness during development. Alongside syntax and semantic highlighting, it provides review and augmentation capabilities to improve developer efficiency and code quality.
content.meta: VSCode Solidity Auditor is a ConsenSys-built extension that adds Solidity support. Discover VSCode Solidity Auditor and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
